_readme: Floral tributes. Prices in US dollars (client request). price null = 'Price on request'. 'priceText' overrides the shown price (e.g. a per-letter rate). 'desc' adds a small line under the price. Photos go in images/flowers/<slug>.jpg, with a ~700px copy in images/thumbs/<slug>.jpg. 'fit':'contain' shows the whole photo.
